VERDICT: LGTM

The new `formatMembershipNumber` is placed exactly where a maintainer would expect: alongside the sibling derived-field formatters `formatDisplayName` and `formatInitials`, which are wired identically via `@Mapping(expression = "java(...)")` on `toOwnerDto`. It mirrors their conventions precisely — same default-method style, same leading null-guard, same javadoc shape documenting the null-return rationale. It is a pure DTO presentation concern, so the mapper is the right unit; nothing is duplicated, and the interface isn't becoming a catch-all (it already legitimately owns this family of formatters). The `membershipNumber` schema entry in `openapi.yml` sits naturally next to the related `customerCode` property and matches its `readOnly`/`example` style.
